key_highlights: ASX finished flat after intraday slump as bond-market volatility rattled Wall Street; miners rose while oil stocks and IDP (IDP.AX) fell sharply
Unemployment hit a 5-year high yet RBA signals another rate hike, testing the bank's credibility and credibility of its inflation mandate
AUD/USD weakened sharply ('pulverised by US boom'), pressuring import costs and commodity exporters
Gold exploration sector active: Auric (AUC.AX), Aureka (ARK.AX), Manhattan (MNG.AX), Forrestania (FRA.AX) all report positive discoveries
Trump diesel export ban and drying global fuel buffers raise energy-cost fears for Australian consumers and transport
Intergenerational Report 2026 flags structural fiscal pressure, reinforcing tax-reform debate
Property market cooling: rising listings, falling demand pushing prices lower; >50% of renters financially stressed
Jetstar (JQZ.AX) industrial action escalates with staff waiving fees; Hastie open to baby bonus return

sectors.trend: Miners outperformed on the day; gold juniors (Auric, Aureka, Manhattan, Forrestania) and copper (Sarytogan) and rare-earths (Lindian) discoveries support sentiment. Gold futures slipped on USD strength but exploration upside remains.
sectors.implications: Gold and copper juniors offer asymmetric upside; major miners (BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX) supported by resilient iron ore but pressured by AUD weakness and Chinese property uncertainty.

sectors.trend: RBA hawkish pivot despite 5-year-high unemployment creates a 'stagflation-lite' backdrop. Higher-for-longer rates pressure mortgage demand and property-linked lending; NIMs may widen but credit risk rises.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX face margin tailwinds from rate hikes but headwinds from property slowdown and renter stress. Bond-market volatility adds uncertainty.

sectors.trend: Oil stocks struggled on the day; Trump diesel export ban and drying global buffers create supply-risk premium. Domestic energy-cost politics (Labor vs Coalition) add noise.
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, WLE.AX, SXG.AX may benefit from supply-tightness premium; downstream refiners face margin compression. Fuel-price pass-through pressures consumer staples.

sectors.trend: Renter stress (>50% financially strained), Jetstar industrial action, and energy-cost fears weigh on discretionary spending. McDonald's grappling with Ozempic demand shift signals structural consumer change.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WTW.AX, JQZ.AX face margin pressure; defensive staples (WOW.AX, CBA.AX) relatively resilient.

sectors.trend: IDP.AX plummeted; $16b Aussie tech firm faces China-link controversy; AI security and workplace AI adoption themes active.
sectors.implications: IDP.AX and education names under pressure from policy and demand shifts; AI-security plays (Netskope) and tech infrastructure remain structurally supported.

sectors.trend: Rising listings, falling demand, and cooling prices signal a structural shift. Renter stress and rate hikes reduce affordability.
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX, DGL.AX) face occupancy and yield pressure; residential property valuations under downward pressure.

key_themes: RBA hawkish divergence: hiking into rising unemployment risks credibility and stagflation narrative
AUD weakness as USD strength and US economic outperformance persist
Trump trade policy (diesel ban, media ban reversal) creating global market cracks
Gold/copper/rare-earths exploration pipeline positive for ASX juniors
Property market cooling with structural demand softening
Energy supply-risk premium from global buffer depletion

risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge with inflation-linked bonds and gold exposure; monitor RBA statement language for dovish pivot signals
Overweight domestic-revenue earners; underweight import-dependent retailers; consider AUD short hedges

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Global bond-market volatility / US policy risk
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce duration risk; diversify into short-duration and credit; monitor US long-bond futures breakout
Underweight residential REITs; favour industrial and healthcare REITs with contracted tenancies
Overweight upstream energy (WDS.AX, WLE.AX); monitor global oil inventories and Trump export policy
Avoid JQZ.AX near-term; monitor Qantas (QAN.AX) as relative beneficiary

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold and copper exploration juniors
opportunities.rationale: Multiple positive discoveries (Auric, Aureka, Manhattan, Forrestania, Sarytogan) plus AUD weakness and bond-market volatility support precious/industrial metals

opportunities.recommendation: Add upstream energy exposure for supply-risk premium
opportunities.rationale: Trump diesel ban and drying global buffers create structural tightness; domestic energy names benefit from price floor

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight major miners on AUD weakness
opportunities.rationale: AUD depreciation boosts AUD-reported earnings for USD-priced commodity exporters; iron ore demand resilient
Intergenerational Report 2026 flags fiscal gap; superannuation and healthcare sectors likely to attract policy support

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce residential REIT and property exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Rising listings, falling demand, renter stress, and rate hikes create downward pressure on valuations

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge bond-market volatility with short-duration and gold
defensive_moves.rationale: US long-bond breakout and RBA hawkish stance create two-way risk; gold provides diversification

defensive_moves.recommendation: Underweight import-dependent consumer and education names
defensive_moves.rationale: AUD weakness raises input costs; IDP.AX already in sharp decline; Jetstar industrial action pressures transport

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain range-bound to slightly lower over 1–3 months. RBA rate hike into rising unemployment creates a stagflation narrative that pressures equities. Bond-market volatility and AUD weakness add headwinds. Miners and energy provide relative strength; property, education, and consumer discretionary lag.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook cautiously constructive if RBA pivots dovish as labour market deteriorates. Intergenerational Report 2026 may catalyse tax and super reform, supporting financials and healthcare. Gold/copper exploration pipeline and rare-earths (Lindian) offer structural growth. Key risk: prolonged AUD weakness and US policy instability.
key_catalysts: RBA next meeting and statement language on unemployment vs inflation trade-off
AUD/USD trajectory and US Fed policy path
Trump trade/export policy developments (diesel ban, media ban)
Chinese property recovery confirmation or further deterioration
Global oil inventory data and energy supply dynamics
watch_list: RBA cash rate and inflation forecast revisions
Iron ore, gold, and copper spot prices
Australian CPI and NAB/ANZ mortgage demand data
Property listings-to-sales ratio and core-logic index
Jetstar (JQZ.AX) and Qantas (QAN.AX) share price action
